release_history.summary: Run live project ensure, conversation bootstrap, ask-live, visual artifact roundtrip, and release-live with the same explicitly bootstrapped release-live slot profile; keep .pb_profile_local_debug optional and stop relying on PROMPTBRANCH_SERVICE_IMAGE_TAG/local fallback for Docker bootstrap defaults.
Repair version coherence across VERSION, promptbranch_version.py, and pyproject.toml so Docker build-context verification and package install report the candidate version.
Release-live browser operations fail fast with docker_live_profile_challenged when Cloudflare/Just-a-moment is detected, without entering manual-login waits or leaving headed Chrome open.
Live ask uses a conversation URL instead of /project and release-control fails fast on Docker live profile Cloudflare challenges.
Preserve .pb_profile_local_debug_pools across release ZIP import so explicitly bootstrapped Docker release-live slots survive install.
Requires explicit Docker-authenticated live profiles for run-all live tests and removes normal FedCM blink-disable fingerprint noise.
Resolves pre_tests auth bootstrap to a current project conversation URL before composer validation, while preserving pre_source_add project-page readiness and held-session clear behavior.
Allows pre_source_add auth bootstrap to accept logged-in project-page readiness without a composer while keeping composer readiness required for conversation/ask/live validation.

Adds a rerunnable sequential API coverage runner as pb test api and scripts/pb-api-coverage-test.sh, with destructive endpoints skipped or guard-tested by default and Project Source mutation requiring explicit flags.

Reuses the held auth-readiness browser session for remembered Project Source overwrite removal and relaxes Project Source held-session checks to authenticated/no-challenge state instead of requiring a chat composer.
Keeps pbsa Project Source add on the project sources route and recovers/fails closed if the Sources tab click escapes to a generic conversation before Add source lookup.
Allows pbsa/promptbranch src add to carry explicit per-request Project Source mutation intent while preserving direct API gate closure and Docker auth/profile preflight.
Repairs pb ask so held-session reuse may not submit from generic ChatGPT when state targets a project conversation; Docker bootstrap/auth-readiness can target the current state URL.
Adds a Docker-launched visible Chrome bootstrap path so the standard profile can be trusted using the same Docker browser fingerprint that auth-readiness and pb ask use.
Repairs held-session pb ask so it sends through the already auth-ready current page and skips direct target conversation navigation that can trigger Cloudflare.
Repairs pb ask so it reuses a compatible held auth-ready browser session and refuses Singleton* cleanup while that session is active.
Repackages the standard browser validation candidate without generated cache entries so release import can proceed to auth-only validation.
Repairs standard browser preserves the Project Source mutation safety gate and adds operator-safe recovery guidance when pbsa/pb src add is used during auth-only standard-browser validation.
Bonnetjes Cloudflare parity profile hygiene documents and guards the clean logged-in Docker auth test path; no Project Source mutation.
Docker parity Cloudflare challenge settling is tested with one held browser session, bounded polling, and safe evidence export; no Project Source mutation.
Docker parity challenge artifacts are exported through bounded /tmp staging instead of wholesale debug tree copies.
